description: This file is a C++ header defining the 'Network' class within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace. It declares a plugin for network management, including methods for querying and configuring network interfaces, IP settings, connectivity, and related events, as well as internal helper functions and subscription mechanisms.

classes.name: Network
classes.description: A plugin class managing network interfaces, IP configurations, connectivity, and event subscriptions within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

methods.name: getInterfaces
methods.description: Retrieves network interface details based on specified parameters.

methods.name: isInterfaceEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether a specified network interface is enabled.

methods.name: setInterfaceEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables a specified network interface.

methods.name: getDefaultInterface
methods.description: Gets the current default network interface.

methods.name: setDefaultInterface
methods.description: Sets a specified interface as the default.

methods.name: doTrace
methods.description: Performs a trace operation for network diagnostics.

methods.name: doPing
methods.description: Performs a ping to test network connectivity.

methods.name: setIPSettings
methods.description: Configures IP settings for an interface.

methods.name: getIPSettings
methods.description: Retrieves current IP settings.

methods.name: getIPSettings2
methods.description: Retrieves an alternative set of IP settings (possibly versioned or different format).

methods.name: isConnectedToInternet
methods.description: Checks whether the device is connected to the internet.

methods.name: setConnectivityTestEndpoints
methods.description: Configures endpoints for connectivity testing.

methods.name: getInternetConnectionState
methods.description: Retrieves the current internet connection state.

methods.name: startConnectivityMonitoring
methods.description: Starts monitoring the device's connectivity status.

methods.name: getCaptivePortalURI
methods.description: Retrieves URI related to captive portal detection.

methods.name: stopConnectivityMonitoring
methods.description: Stops the connectivity monitoring.

methods.name: getPublicIP
methods.description: Retrieves the public IP address.

methods.name: setStunEndpoint
methods.description: Sets STUN server endpoint for NAT traversal.

methods.name: getStbIp
methods.description: Retrieves the IP address of the set-top box.

methods.name: getSTBIPFamily
methods.description: Retrieves the IP family (IPv4/IPv6) of the set-top box.

ctags.name: Network
ctags.pattern: /^        class Network : public PluginHost::IPlugin, public PluginHost::JSONRPC$/
